CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "access_token" text,
  "expires_at" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "id_token" text,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "scope" text,
  "session_state" text,
  "token_type" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."address" (
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "country" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isDefault" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "line1" text NOT NULL,
  "line2" text,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "postalCode" text,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cart" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cartItem" (
  "cartId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "variantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collection" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collectionProduct" (
  "collectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("collectionId", "productId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventoryAdjustment" (
  "adminId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "quantityDelta" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "variantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventoryAdjustment_reason_check_8e6ef6ba" CHECK ("reason" IN ('RESTOCK', 'MANUAL_CORRECTION', 'DAMAGED', 'ORDER', 'RETURN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification" (
  "audience" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text,
  "readAt" timestamptz,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_audience_check_f620f2a6" CHECK ("audience" IN ('ADMIN', 'CUSTOMER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "discountAmount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orderNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "paymentProvider" text,
  "paymentReference" text,
  "paymentStatus" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "promotionCode" text,
  "shippedAt" timestamptz,
  "shippingAddress" json NOT NULL,
  "shippingAmount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'CONFIRMED' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" int4 NOT NULL,
  "total" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_paymentStatus_check_60515b20" CHECK ("paymentStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED')),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_check_cff69d1a" CHECK ("status" IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orderItem" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "orderId" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text,
  "productName" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" int4 NOT NULL,
  "variantId" text,
  "variantLabel" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orderStatusHistory" (
  "actorId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "orderStatusHistory_status_check_cff69d1a" CHECK ("status" IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "baseNotes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "bestSeller" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "concentration" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "featured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "fragranceFamily" text NOT NULL,
  "heartNotes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "intensity" text NOT NULL,
  "isNew" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "occasions" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "shortDescription" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "tags" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "topNotes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "product_baseNotes_elem_not_null_59c5882a" CHECK (array_position("baseNotes", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "product_heartNotes_elem_not_null_d4087b8b" CHECK (array_position("heartNotes", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "product_occasions_elem_not_null_2a0b5360" CHECK (array_position("occasions", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "product_tags_elem_not_null_aecbe9e2" CHECK (array_position("tags", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "product_topNotes_elem_not_null_9af29fb7" CHECK (array_position("topNotes", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."productImage" (
  "alt" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "publicId" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "productImage_role_check_091df971" CHECK ("role" IN ('CATALOG', 'EDITORIAL', 'GALLERY', 'DETAIL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."productVariant" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "compareAtPrice" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lowStockThreshold" int4 DEFAULT 4 NOT NULL,
  "price" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "size" text NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "stock" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."promotion" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "minimumOrder" int4,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "usageLimit" int4,
  "value" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "promotion_type_check_9def900f" CHECK ("type" IN ('PERCENTAGE', 'FIXED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."promotionUsage" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text NOT NULL,
  "promotionId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."scentProfile" (
  "answers" json NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "intensity" text,
  "occasions" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "preferredFamilies" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "preferredNotes" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "recommendations" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "scentProfile_occasions_elem_not_null_2a0b5360" CHECK (array_position("occasions", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "scentProfile_preferredFamilies_elem_not_null_78ea673d" CHECK (array_position("preferredFamilies", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "scentProfile_preferredNotes_elem_not_null_0c007a99" CHECK (array_position("preferredNotes", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "scentProfile_recommendations_elem_not_null_d88cb20d" CHECK (array_position("recommendations", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "expires" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionToken" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "passwordHash" text,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_3cc42c46" CHECK ("role" IN ('CUSTOMER', 'ADMIN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verificationToken" (
  "expires" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wishlist" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wishlistItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "wishlistId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
